quotations.old_english: Hé áhsode hwæt alexander se cyning dyde and húlíc mon hé wǽre and in hwylcere yldo
quotations.english: he asked what king Alexander was doing, and what sort of man he was, and of what age

quotations.old_english: Nú ic wille secgan húlucu heó wæs
quotations.english: I will tell you what it [Carthage] was like

quotations.old_english: Húlíc is se organ tó begonganne
Gisih húlíce [húlco, Lind.] stánas and húlíc [huulig, Lind.] timber
quotations.latin: aspice quales lapides et quales structuræ

source_text: hú-líc; pron. Of what sort; qualis :-- Hé áhsode hwæt alexander se cyning dyde and húlíc mon hé wǽre and in hwylcere yldo he asked what king Alexander was doing, and what sort of man he was, and of what age, Nar. 18, 12. Nú ic wille secgan húlucu heó wæs I will tell you what it [Carthage] was like, Ors. 4, 13; Bos. 99, 57. Húlíc is ðes qualis est hic? Mt. Kmbl. Rush. 8, 27. Húlíc is se organ tó begonganne, Salm. Kmbl. 107; Sal. 53. Húlig, Lk. Skt. Lind. 1, 29. Gisih húlíce [húlco, Lind.] stánas and húlíc [huulig, Lind.] timber aspice quales lapides et quales structuræ, Mk. Skt. Rush. 13, 1. v. hwilc.
